intent: Fix three measured zero-citation GEO gaps on existing restaurant and chatbot pages

visual_evidence.scope_reason: The repair changes server-rendered answer-first copy and metadata inside established service-page components; it does not change the visual system or interaction model.
visual_evidence.correction_excerpt:
**Test:** en cualquier money page, el precio (o la respuesta) alcanzable sin scroll o a un
toque; profundidad en `<details>` servido en el HTML, no desmontado.
visual_evidence.comparison: The live 390px service-page captures establish the existing layout. The repair must preserve its visible H1, price/context and quote action while making the local service answer unambiguous in server HTML.

brief.visitor: A Miami restaurant owner looking for a videographer, or a Fort Lauderdale/Miami small-business owner looking for a bilingual AI chatbot.
brief.promise: The first screen plainly identifies the service, place, supported channels, published proof and the next action.
brief.primary_action: Ask Esteban for a scoped quote.
brief.friction: The measured prompts do not currently receive an owned-domain citation, although the facts and pages already exist.

kpi.outcome: Owned-domain citations on the three measured prompt/engine checks.
kpi.denominator: 12 engine/prompt checks across three zero-citation prompts
kpi.baseline: 0 owned-domain citations for each prompt in the 2026-10-19 tracker run
kpi.readout: Next scheduled citation tracker run after production recrawl.
kpi.decision_rule: Keep only factual answers; treat a later citation as observed visibility, not proof of a ranking mechanism.

concept.idea: Strengthen the two fact-backed canonical service pages instead of multiplying routes.
concept.brand_reason: Esteban pages are concise, price-clear service paths with published work as proof.
concept.interaction: Existing native page navigation and quote action remain unchanged.
concept.visible_response: The H1 and first answer directly include restaurant videographer Miami, Fort Lauderdale small-business chatbot, and Spanish Miami chatbot intent.
concept.direct_path: Quote CTA remains visible before the supporting FAQ cards.
concept.alternatives: Do not amplify the unsupported fine-dining page or claim chatbot clients/results not published.

story.action: Visitor sees scope, price boundary and factual proof.
story.consequence: Visitor can request a quote with the correct context.
story.next_step: Measure raw HTML in production, submit IndexNow, then recheck citation tracker.

content.visible: One answer-first line and metadata refinement on existing pages; existing FAQ sections stay visible.
content.optional_html: Existing ServiceDeepDive native details stays server-rendered.
content.linked_depth: Published Bar Door Monkey proof and existing chatbot portfolio projects.

references.borrow: Existing WebAiServicePageView and restaurant promo service layout.
references.avoid: New thin routes, unsupported restaurant-client claims, promised results, or visual redesign.

components.reuse: WebAiServicePageView, ServiceDeepDive, existing restaurant promo page, existing rail-kit-backed project setup.
components.local_reason: No new component is needed for factual copy and metadata correction.

verification.rendered_states: Existing desktop and short-phone layouts at 390x664 and 375x600 retain a visible H1 and primary action without overlap.
verification.accessibility_performance: Run focused render/metadata tests and existing lint/type/build gates.
verification.raw_html: After deployment, curl each changed URL and assert the exact answer-first phrase appears in server HTML.
verification.conversion_boundary: A production citation or customer inquiry is not claimed until independently observed.

reviewers.behavior: Codex tests and production raw-HTML check
reviewers.outcome: Claude specification/verification through the CTO dispatch path

learning.target: restaurant videographer Miami; AI chatbot Fort Lauderdale; Spanish AI chatbot Miami
learning.hypothesis: An answer-first, local, factual canonical page makes the existing service easier for engines to select and cite.
learning.decision_rule: Do not infer causality from a single answer; compare the same prompts and engines against this baseline.
learning.registration_condition: Record deployment SHA and exact raw-HTML checks before the next tracker run.
